correctness.rationale: For n>=4 an inclusion-maximal intersecting edge family is a complete star or a 3-edge triangle; this follows from considering two meeting edges ab,ac. Any shattered support cannot contain disjoint edges; support of size four cannot realize the three-positive one-negative pattern. Every intersecting triple is a 3-star or triangle, and explicit star/triangle extensions realize all 8 patterns. The pair-codegree of maximal cliques is <=2, excluding depth-4 Littlestone trees, whereas a fixed shattered triple gives depth 3. Face counts give the stated polynomial; simple connectivity of the two-skeleton follows from known line-graph clique topology and the fact that cells above dimension two do not affect fundamental groups. Euler characteristic then gives beta_2=C(n,2)+(n-5)C(n,3)-1 and a wedge of spheres. Independent exhaustive tests on n=4,5 gave coefficients (1,6,12,8) and (1,10,30,30); no extrapolation from these checks.
